islands.name: Frostholm
islands.env: Frostholm, a frozen tundra island near the pole. Winter lasts nine months at -40 C with blizzards and deep snow. The ground is permafrost. The only plants are moss, lichen and low shrubs. Lemmings live under the snow, and the coast has fish and seals under the sea ice. There are almost no trees.
islands.season: the nine-month polar winter at -40 C

islands.name: The Shelf
islands.env: The Shelf, a deep ocean shelf with no dry land at all: only open cold sea water, kelp forests, and the dark sea floor. There are schools of fish, plankton, crabs and squid. Anything that cannot swim and breathe at sea drowns.
islands.season: the winter storm season with huge waves and freezing water

islands.name: Verdance
islands.env: Verdance, a hot, humid rainforest island. Giant trees form a canopy 50 meters up where most fruit, flowers and insects are. The forest floor is dark, wet and muddy. It rains every day. There are many snakes, birds and big cats.
islands.season: the monsoon, with months of flooding rain

islands.name: Sedge Plains
islands.env: Sedge Plains, a wide open grassland savanna with very few trees and nowhere to hide. Grass and seeds are everywhere. Fast predators chase grazing herds across the open ground. Wildfires sweep the grass in the dry season.
islands.season: the dry season with grass fires

islands.name: Ashara
islands.env: Ashara, a scorching sand desert island. Daytime is 50 C with no shade, nights are cold. It rains once every few years and there is no standing water. Plants are only cactus, dry seeds and thorny scrub. Insects and lizards hide in the sand.
islands.season: a two-year drought with no rain at all

islands.name: Cinder
islands.env: Cinder, an active volcanic island of black lava rock. Hot vents release toxic gas, the ground is hot enough to burn feet, and ash falls often. Almost nothing grows except bacteria mats around hot springs and a few hardy ferns. Insects and seabirds visit the coast.
islands.season: an eruption that buries the island in ash

islands.name: Hollowdeep
islands.env: Hollowdeep, a huge cave system with no light at all. It is always pitch dark, cool and damp, with underground rivers and narrow tunnels. Food is fungus, cave insects, blind fish and bat droppings. Eyes are useless here.
islands.season: a lean year when the bat colony leaves and food runs out
